_what: How the engine finds the record model in the tools installed for an account (src/record_model_policy/installed.rs). Each Workshop tool row (an ai-tool-descriptor in its folder's tool-rows.json, or one of the engine's own rows in src/tool_runs/tools/tool-runs.json `engine_rows`) may hold `row_field`: an object in the record model's own shape, holding only the kinds, value kinds, list rules, field kinds, indexes and links that tool keeps. The engine joins `own_part` first, then every tool's object into one model with generic code and names no kind: a section that is a list is the tools' lists one after another in catalog order (the engine's rows first), and a section that is an object is their keys together. Two tools giving one object key, or two rows of a listed section with the same `unique` fields, refuse the whole model, as two tool rows with one id refuse the catalog. A kind whose row says `device_only` true stays on this computer; when the account's Workshop is not found or its model refuses, every kind does.

own_part._what: The kinds the engine itself writes, and the value kinds every part's properties use (old trillion src/record-model.json value_kinds and its setting, execution, resource-command-result and table-schema-change rows, moved here unchanged): plain settings (src/record_log/original_setting.rs) the command journal's receipts (src/record_write_model/own-record-writes.json receipt_kinds) and a table's schema changes (src/storage/kind_views.rs SCHEMA_KIND), with the one index of plain settings (from old trillion src/record-indexes.json). Every other kind is a tool's.

kinds._what: A held value of the account vault, one record per value (id = its name, value = its sealed envelope). Only the vault reads it: a record kind with readers set is answered to no door read, search or list, and no tool row may declare it (src/record_model_policy/installed.rs owner_only).

kinds._read_by: src/record-scope.mjs and read_model: exact targets in links.record_refs, plus ordered references with their declared role, input/result basis and source field path; named input does not establish consumption

parts/record-log/do-work/record-log-store.mjs: one dated change to a table kind's schema (kind_added, table_rebuilt, field_added, field_type_changed, field_removed, field_restored, index_added, index_removed), written in the transaction that made it

indexes.name: tool_choice_at
indexes._read_by: src/tool-choice-keep.mjs (the choices kept for tool jobs by when each was last offered or chosen from, oldest first: only those hold an entry, so the sweep that drops the ones unused for 30 days is one seek and a page)
